items.headline: Ranking college football's best 60 receivers of the last 50 years
items.description: As Jeremiah Smith continues to amaze, Bill Connelly looks at where his career fits among the best ever.

items.headline: Herschel Turner runs for 192 yards and Nevada dominates on defense in 30-13 win over UTEP
items.description: — Herschel Turner ran for a career-high 192 yards and his 72-yard touchdown burst broke the game open in the third quarter, leading Nevada to a 30-13 victory over UTEP on Saturday night.

items.headline: College football Bottom 10 after Week 5: Michigan is back for more
items.description: Apparently the Wolverines were so comfortable on our dubious list last week, they decided to stick around.

items.headline: Nevada and UTEP meet in MWC play
items.description: Nevada (1-3) at UTEP (1-4), Oct. 10 at 7 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: College football Bottom 10 after Week 4: Time not on Michigan's side
items.description: After a controversial last-second win earlier in the season, the tables were turned on the Wolverines.

items.headline: Rocco Conti's TD run lifts Air Force to 36-33 victory over Nevada in 2OT
items.description: — Rocco Conti scored on a 7-yard run in the second overtime and Air Force rallied last in a 36-33 victory over Nevada on Saturday night in the Wolf Pack's Mountain West Conference opener.
